== Biography ==
An extracted Scottish baptism index records James Glasgow as born on 30 November 1736 and baptised on 12 December 1736 at Kilwinning, Ayrshire, Scotland. It names his father as James Glasgow but does not name a mother.<ref name="baptism">“Scotland, Select Births and Baptisms, 1564–1950,” database, Ancestry ([https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/60143/records/24655586 record 24655586] : accessed 30 August 2026), James Glasgow, born 30 November 1736, baptised 12 December 1736, Kilwinning, Ayrshire, father James Glasgow; extracted index, original register image not inspected.</ref>

== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-3969]] is assessed at 17% (uncertain). James’s 1736 transcript names James and Isabell Ross, but the selected father account represents a 1691 Beith marriage, forty-five years earlier, with birth before 1670. Same parental names do not overcome that severe couple-generation problem.

Complete selected father-profile proposition, with identity limits below.

Next useful test: Compare the 1691 Beith marriage and original 1736 Kilwinning baptism; seek a younger James/Isabell Ross couple.

Source basis already held: [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=SCOT%2FOPR%2FBAP%2F3627666&tab=this Findmypast, Scotland, Parish Births & Baptisms 1564-1929: James Glasgow, 12 Dec 1736, record SCOT/OPR/BAP/3627666]; [https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:XTKY-MM2 "Scotland, Marriages, 1561-1910", , FamilySearch (https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:XTKY-MM2 : 11 February 2020), James Glasgow, 1691.]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.



=== Birth and parentage conflicts ===

The baptism index supports the dates, Kilwinning and a father named James, but it does not identify that father as the attached [[Glasgow-3969|James Glasgow]] and it does not name [[Ross-23403|Issabell Ross]]. The structured birth field also still says Glasgow, Lanarkshire. The original Old Parish Register image should be inspected before treating the exact birthplace or either attached parent as proved.<ref>[https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk/help-and-support/guides/church-registers “Church registers,” Scotland's People], collection guide; accessed 30 August 2026.</ref>

The earlier biography cited a FamilySearch index entry for a James Glasgow in '''1645'''; it cannot support this 1736 birth or baptism.<ref>“Scotland Births and Baptisms, 1564–1950,” FamilySearch (https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:VQHK-VMK : accessed 16 September 2021), James Glasgow, 1645.</ref>

A RootsChat discussion also mentions possible earlier James Glasgow baptisms, but it is a research lead rather than evidence of this James's parents or later identity.<ref>[https://www.rootschat.com/forum/index.php?topic=702337.0 “Parents of James Glasgow (1799–1862), Ayrshire,” RootsChat], discussion used as a search lead only.</ref>

The attached father was formerly shown as dying in 1726, which would make the relationship chronologically impossible. Both parents and the present structured location are retained pending an evidenced replacement, in accordance with the [[Space:Glasgow Branches in Early Ireland|Glasgow Branches in Early Ireland]] review. No inspected record yet proves a move to Cookstown.
